story.iWant: to search for customers and see results in a paginated list

tasks.task: Integrate API call to search customers (AC: #4, #9)
Implement empty state and error states (AC: #6, #8)

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Search form with query input, status filter dropdown, Search and Clear buttons
Pressing Enter in search input submits search
Results displayed in data table with columns: ID, Name, Email, Phone, Status, Actions. Sortable columns. Pagination controls (Previous/Next, "Page X of Y", rows per page selector)
Actions column with View/Edit buttons and More menu (with delete option and confirmation)
Empty state message if no results: "No customers found. Try different search criteria."
Loading state while fetching (spinner centered on page)
Error message if search fails (with retry button)
Performance: < 2s load time for typical searches (use debouncing on search input, 300ms delay)
Accessibility: keyboard navigation, ARIA labels on buttons, screen reader support

constraint.rule: Debounce search input with 300ms delay to prevent excessive API calls while user is typing.
Use useSearchParams hook to read/write URL query parameters. Format: ?query=...&status=...&page=...&limit=...&sortBy=...&sortOrder=...
Implement offset-based pagination (not cursor-based). Calculate offset from page number and limit. Provide Previous/Next buttons and rows-per-page selector.
Implement clickable column headers for sorting. Track sortBy (column) and sortOrder (ASC/DESC). Show visual indicator (arrow) on active sort column.
Display user-friendly error messages with retry button. Don't expose internal error details. Handle network failures, API errors, and validation errors.
ARIA labels on all interactive elements. Keyboard navigation (Tab through table, Enter to select row). Screen reader support for status badges and action buttons.

interface.name: CustomerService.searchCustomers API
interface.signature: searchCustomers(query: SearchQuery): Promise<SearchResult<Customer>> - query parameters: {query?, status?, limit, offset, sortBy, sortOrder}
interface.description: API wrapper for GET /api/v1/customers endpoint. Story 3.4 calls this method with search parameters to fetch paginated customer list.

interface.name: useSearchParams Hook
interface.signature: const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams() - manages URL query parameters
interface.description: React Router hook for reading and writing URL query parameters. Story 3.4 uses this to preserve search state in URL for sharing and bookmarking.

interface.name: MUI Table Component
interface.signature: Table, TableHead, TableBody, TableCell, TableRow, TablePagination from @mui/material
interface.description: Material-UI table components used to display customer search results with sortable headers and pagination controls.

tests.standards: Unit tests use Jest + React Testing Library. Integration tests verify search, sorting, pagination, and error handling. Manual testing for performance (< 2s load time) and accessibility.

ideas.idea: Verify search form renders with query input and filter dropdown; Enter key submits search
Verify customer data displays in table with all columns; columns are sortable with visual indicators
Verify pagination controls work: Previous/Next navigate pages, rows-per-page selector updates limit
Verify View/Edit buttons navigate to customer detail/edit pages; More menu shows delete with confirmation
Verify empty state message displays when no search results
Verify spinner shows while API call in progress
Verify error message and retry button appear on API failure
Verify URL reflects current search state and can be shared/bookmarked
Measure page load time and API response time; verify debouncing prevents excessive calls
Verify keyboard navigation (Tab through table), ARIA labels on buttons, screen reader compatibility
